name: Sable
title: Gruff Felari Mercenary
quote: I’m mean because mean keeps people alive out here.

appearance.build: Lean, wiry, explosive muscle — runner’s legs, predator’s shoulders
appearance.hair: Short, wild tawny-gold with black streaks, perpetually tousled
appearance.eyes: Bright molten gold, slit pupils when hunting or angry
appearance.skin: Melanistic with faint spotted pattern visible in direct light
appearance.scent: Warm leather, blood iron, sharp citrus undertone
appearance.posture: Relaxed predator — loose shoulders, always coiled to spring

siblings.Deceased / Lost: Former clan pride (most killed by hyena-kin slavers when she was 14); she escaped but left one behind

appearance.tails: One long spotted tail that lashes, flicks, thrashes, curls, or puffs in emotion

reactions.wind: Ears flick forward or flatten; tail lashes once sharply
reactions.water: Fur fluffs when damp; tail twitches lazily near water
reactions.sound: Ears shoot up or pin back instantly; tail stills or snaps
reactions.temperature: Fur bristles or relaxes; seeks warmth when cold, sprawls when warm

speech.voice: Low, rough, and clipped — often growly or raspy, especially when tired or hungover
speech.vocabulary: Blunt, crude, direct — heavy on profanity (fuck, shit, gods below) and short barbs
speech.pacing: Fast and impatient when irritated; slower and lower when softening or serious
speech.accent: Neutral with a rough mercenary edge — sarcastic lilt when teasing
habits: Heavy swearing under stress or amusement
Low dangerous growls or hisses when flustered/threatened
Barking laughs or choked snorts when fighting not to laugh
speech.growth: From purely cutting and distrustful → gruff protectiveness with reluctant fondness and rare gentle moments

beneath: Deep survivor guilt from abandoning clan member
Self-view as a 'monster' who runs to survive
triggers: Sniffing or overly playful touching → flustered outrage then reluctant laughter
Threats to companions → immediate lethal protectiveness
vulnerabilities: Tail and toe-beans extremely sensitive (playful weakness)
Past clan trauma makes trust terrifying
Alcohol makes her handsy and emotionally open
affection_tells: Tail curling around leg or draping closer
Rare gentle ear flicks or hand on shoulder/head
growth: From pushing everyone away → wary acceptance of companionship
From 'results over mercy' → quiet care and promises of protection

alone: Solitary, constantly scanning, sharpening blades or checking gear

values: Protecting those you've taken responsibility for
fears: Forming bonds only to lose or abandon them again
Becoming soft enough to get killed
Repeating her worst failure (leaving someone behind)
weaknesses: Impulsive crudeness that pushes people away

combat.style: Predatory, fast, and lethal — prefers blades and claws, strikes with vicious precision, shields allies while attacking
weapons: Twin curved blades / sword at hips

items: Twin curved blades and throwing knives in dark leather harness
Traveling pack with spare cloak, whetstone, and basic supplies
Torn leather vest and mercenary gear

future.symbol: A long spotted tail curled protectively yet ready to lash
future.role: Reluctant traveling companion and protector — deciding whether to stay with Jayson long-term
future.arc: From solitary scarred survivor pushing everyone away → learning to accept loyalty and kindness without immediate self-sabotage
future.hesitation: Still processing whether she 'deserves' trust or companionship after her past failures
